name: MONO Champaca
shortDescription: A gated development of 3 and 4 bedroom pool villas by The Attitude Club in Thalang, inland in northern Phuket, inspired by modern rural Asian and Japanese-minimal design.
description: A gated development of 3 and 4 bedroom pool villas by The Attitude Club in Thalang, inland in northern Phuket, inspired by modern rural Asian and Japanese-minimal design. Villas offer roughly 237-425 sqm built area on plots of about 400-740 sqm, each with a saltwater pool and smart-home system. Units are sold made-to-order.
facilities: Private saltwater pool, pool lounge, sundeck
researchNotes: Heavily conflicting data between sources (units 5/15/65, completion, price, size). FazWaz 'second area' ranges (303-744 sqm) assumed to be land but not labelled. Official developer site not found. Captions inferred. | Differs from claim. FazWaz header: from 17,800,000 (listing 17,900,000, range 17.9M-32M). Keller Henson shows 16.0M for 3BR Type E, 19.5M for 3BR Type A (promotion), up to 29.9M. Prices conflict between agents; no developer-official price found. | claimed price 18500000
